mediaWork.title: Accused
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Multi-season investigative journalism examining questionable convictions, flawed police investigations, and unsolved murders.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Investigative podcast from The Cincinnati Enquirer hosted by reporter Amber Hunt (52 episodes). Several seasons—including Season 2 (William Virgil, exonerated after 28 years in Kentucky) and Season 4 (Elwood Jones)—directly investigate wrongful or deeply disputed convictions.
mediaWork.availabilityNotes: Apple Podcasts · Public RSS feed verified · ~52 episodes on Apple Podcasts
